tv_wonder_new_accept_proposal_tooltip_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_proposal ?= 1 }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LOCK_SACRED_MOUNTAIN_TT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_proposal ?= 2 }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LOCK_TRIUMPHAL_AXIS_TT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_proposal ?= 3 }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LOCK_GREAT_PORT_TT }

tv_wonder_copy_large_canal_system_survey_from_location_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_scale_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_logistics_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_large_canal_system_organization_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_new_apply_survey_site_preference_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 19
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { OR = { has_river = yes is_adjacent_to_lake = yes is_port = yes } } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 10 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }

		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 20

		}

tv_wonder_new_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 19 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_large_canal_system } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 20 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_mountain_terrace_network } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 21 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_giant_dam_project } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 22 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_royal_granary_system } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 23 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_imperial_post_road_network } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 24 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_canal_hub_city } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 25 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_frontier_colonization_belt } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 26 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_coastal_beacon_network } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 27 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_knightly_fortress_order } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 28 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_war_college_system } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 29 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_great_clock_bell_system } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 30 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_royal_art_district } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 31 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_grand_theater_festival_district } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 32 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_world_embassy_quarter } }
				AND = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 33 scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_law_code_stele_project } }

tv_wonder_new_broadcast_completion_event_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_sacred_mountain
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_triumphal_axis
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_great_port
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_giant_necropolis
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 5 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_great_lighthouse
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6 }
